bio: Located in the pedestrian area, not far from the Rhine River, this modern yet cosy little restaurant serves ambitious seasonal cuisine in the evening. You can either order the set menu or choose à la carte; on Wednesday and Thursday evenings there is also an appealing sharing menu for two. Vegetarian options are also available if ordered in advance. For lunch, there are simpler, more moderately priced daily specials. Delicatessen goods and wine can be purchased to enjoy at home....
